title: A 5760 by 3840 file on XAVC HS 4K and XAVC S 4K at 23.98p and 25p: encoder request, two encoder cores, the 4K memory blocks in an order that holds the picture, descriptors, profiles and the monitoring label
goes_with: dmmwb4688_v1 + ogsq_v3 (the baseline) and og57cp_v1 (output size, four scaler engines, the output buffer), all in coprocessor RAM
level: Level 6 (HEVC 180, AVC 60); Level 6.1 (183, 61) in the 300 Mbps profiles
encoder_cores: both (UseCore 2), as every stock descriptor above 249 million pixels a second
while_applied: the formats' other frame rates find no descriptor: their recordings are refused at encoder open
the container and the metadata still say 3840 by 2160

the 100M record settings (and any higher one of these formats) record at 300 Mbps; the lower settings keep their bit rate; the menu, the remaining-time figure and the container's own bit-rate fields still say what the setting says
